paper_metadata.title: Fabrication of a high strength Mg-11Gd-4.5Y-1Nd-1.5Zn-0.5Zr (wt.%) alloy by thermomechanical treatments

Mg-11Gd-4.5Y-1.5Zn-1Nd-0.5Zr alloy was casted at 760 ± 3 °C under gas protection of mixed SF6/CO2 (1:99) with a cylindrical steel mould having a diameter of 92 mm. The mould was preheated to 200 °C.
Homogenization annealing was performed at 535 °C for 24 h followed by quenching in water (25 °C).
The homogenized billet was machined into round bar with a diameter of 82 mm and length of 120 mm for subsequent extrusion with a ratio of ~30:1 under a ram speed of 1.0 mm•s-1.
the cold rolling was carried out in the extrusion direction with a thickness reduction of 5% per pass up to the total reduction of 14.5%.
